rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Your Majesty, thank you very much for
appointing me special envoy on this
expedition.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0002
rows.name:
On this ship, His Majesty's attendants
include some of the finest people
chosen back home.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0003
rows.name:
To be chosen for this is the greatest
honor I could have as one who serves
His Majesty.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But the Special Commissioner is
different... Yuugo-sama's elder
brother gives orders, not Yuugo-sama.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Yuugo-sama's elder brother is cold—
sending a Commissioner just to confirm
the death and recover banner Cores.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I intend to keep serving His Majesty
by my own will.

rows.label: tlk70000074_02_msg0007
rows.name:
And I ask all of you as well: please
keep His Majesty safe.
